reason: This PR appears to refactor the execution path for auto-analyze by routing analysis jobs through a worker and changing statistics-handle interfaces. That is a central statistics-path change rather than a local fix: if scheduling, session usage, or job lifecycle handling is wrong, stats refresh can silently stop, duplicate, or regress, which can impact optimizer inputs across many workloads. That is enough blast radius to justify a Blocker/High-focused deep review.
